core_obligations: Reduce to the presentation: since the source module is cyclic it suffices to check that the image of its generator satisfies the defining relations of that module (proof lines 670-671)

Two displayed families: the proof records the relations which the class of the tensor of the two generators satisfies in the tensor product of the factors, namely the Cartan action and the annihilation by a high power of a negative root vector, together with the annihilation of the image by the twisted Cartan part (proof lines 672-685)

Use the fusion product lemma: the positive and negative annihilation relations inside the two factors, transported through the fusion product by the lemma labelled f2, give the remaining relations satisfied by the image (proof lines 686-697)

Dimension bound: the surjectivity of the map, together with the multiplicativity of the dimension under the fusion product, gives the displayed inequality whose label lies inside the counted span (statement lines 663-667)
proof_roadmap: 源模 V_{i,k+1} 循环，故只需验证 ψ(v̄) 满足其定义关系：先在张量积里记下两条显示的关系（Cartan 的作用与高次负根向量的零化），以及 ψ 的像被扭曲的 Cartan 部分零化。
再用 lemma f2 把两个因子里的正/负根向量零化关系传过融合积，即得剩下的关系；于是 ψ 良定义且满，配合维数在融合积下的乘性得到带 label dimg 的下界。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement exhibits a well-defined surjective map from the cyclic module attached to one pair of parameters onto a fusion product of a Demazure module and copies of the evaluation module of the fundamental representation, and deduces the lower bound for its dimension displayed with the article's label dimg (author proposition without an author label, statement at source lines 659-668). The proof (source lines 669-698) reduces to the presentation of the source module, records the relations satisfied in the tensor product of the factors, and transports them to the fusion product by the lemma labelled f2 to verify the remaining relations (proof lines 670-697). The transport of the annihilation relations through the fusion product is the content. H2.
